decisions.correction: Nagoji's brand and long white scar exist ONLY on the inner side of his LEFT forearm, a hand's width above the wrist. In this panel his RIGHT hand raises the knife: draw that whole right arm, forearm and elbow as clean, smooth, unmarked skin with no patch, scar, pale line, blemish or texture anywhere. His LEFT hand cradles the plain dark wooden sheath on the falling red cloth; with that left sleeve rolled back, show the pale puckered brand patch (raised ridges, no letters, numerals or cross) on the inner left forearm a hand's width above the wrist with a thin white scar running from wrist toward elbow beside it, or keep that left forearm in shadow so no mark shows at all. Keep everything else from the last version: seated on the black mirror floor of the lamplit courtyard, bare-headed with long loose curly hair, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, tiny flush gold ear stud, cream tunic and broad red sash, the straight dagger with a hand-span blade, ivory grip and gold guard and pommel held up catching the lamplight, quiet roof shadow high in the frame for two balloons, and a low-detail lower corner for the inset.
